# BOTLYTICES — Digital Technology, Web Development & AI Automation Studio

## Business Summary
BOTLYTICES is an international technology, web development, and digital automation studio founded and led by Muhammad Ali Husnain Nawab. Operating remotely from Pakistan, BOTLYTICES provides high-performance web engineering, managed IT infrastructure, local search optimization, AI-driven automation, and commercial security surveillance to businesses worldwide across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Europe, and the UAE.

All services are delivered at approximately one-third the cost of conventional Western web and digital agencies through direct engineer collaboration with zero executive bloat.

## Core Service Divisions

### Division 01: Web Design, UI/UX & Web Development
- Canonical Path: https://botlytices.com/services/web-development/web-design-ui-ux-development
- Dedicated Website Maintenance & Management: https://botlytices.com/services/web-development/website-maintenance (alias https://botlytices.com/website-maintenance)
- Overview: Full-cycle Figma UI/UX prototyping, modern responsive web development (React 19, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS), custom e-commerce stores (Shopify, WooCommerce), and comprehensive ongoing website care, speed optimization, and security management for tourism, real estate, hospitality, e-commerce, and corporate clients.
- Key Pricing Benchmark: Built at 1/3 conventional agency rates (Landing pages from $189, 5-page business sites from $399, e-commerce stores from $999, ongoing monthly maintenance packages: Essential $49/mo, Professional $99/mo, Business & Advanced $189/mo).

### Division 02: IT Support & Infrastructure
- Canonical Path: https://botlytices.com/services/it-support
- Overview: Remote and office IT support, desktop/laptop hardware diagnostics, Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace setup, Cat6 structured cabling, enterprise Wi-Fi 6/7 deployment, and endpoint cybersecurity.
- Pricing Benchmark: Remote IT troubleshooting from $59/hr; Essential IT Care from $199/month.

### Division 03: Digital Presence & Local Search (SEO)
- Canonical Path: https://botlytices.com/services/digital-presence
- Overview: Multi-channel brand identity, verified Google Business Profile setup, Apple Business Connect, Bing Places, local citation networks, and on-page technical SEO/AEO.
- Pricing Benchmark: Local Presence Setup from $349/month; Full Growth Optimization from $699/month.

### Division 04: AI Automation & Smart Desk
- Canonical Path: https://botlytices.com/services/ai-automation
- Overview: 24/7 conversational AI voice receptionists (Twilio, Retell, Vapi), official Meta WhatsApp Business automation, automated lead qualification, and CRM integrations (HubSpot, Make, Zapier).
- Pricing Benchmark: AI Web Assistant setup from $499 + $79/mo; WhatsApp AI Lead Pipeline from $899 + $129/mo.

### Division 05: Security & Surveillance Systems
- Canonical Path: https://botlytices.com/services/security-surveillance
- Overview: Commercial 4K IP CCTV surveillance systems (Hikvision, Dahua, Reolink), biometric/RFID access control, secure remote mobile video viewing, and scheduled maintenance.
- Pricing Benchmark: Remote NVR/IP configuration from $249; Commercial Turnkey packages from $999.
